# Vendored runtime libraries

- react 18.3.1, MIT, https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
- react-dom 18.3.1, MIT, https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js
- @babel/standalone 7.29.0, MIT, https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.29.0/babel.min.js

The sha384 of each file equals the SRI constant in app/support.js (checked by apps/web/tests/unit/vendor-runtime-no-unpkg.test.ts).
